constraints: FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES auth.oauth_clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
relations.name: oauth_authorizations

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (oauth_client_id) REFERENCES auth.oauth_clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
relations.name: sessions

policies.name: eps_mcp_own_session
policies.using: ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (id = ( SELECT eps.mcp_claim_uuid('session_id'::text) AS mcp_claim_uuid)) AND (oauth_client_id = ( SELECT eps.mcp_claim_uuid('client_id'::text) AS mcp_claim_uuid)))

policies.name: oauth_consent_ordinary_own_session
policies.using: ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ((id)::text = ( SELECT (auth.jwt() ->> 'session_id'::text))) AND (oauth_client_id IS NULL))

ledger_policy.check: ((principal_id = ( SELECT ((eps.oauth_consent_browser_context() ->> 'principal_id'::text))::uuid AS uuid)) AND (session_id = ( SELECT ((eps.oauth_consent_browser_context() ->> 'session_id'::text))::uuid AS uuid)))
ledger_policy.name: oauth_consent_own_claim
ledger_policy.using: ((principal_id = ( SELECT ((eps.oauth_consent_browser_context() ->> 'principal_id'::text))::uuid AS uuid)) AND (session_id = ( SELECT ((eps.oauth_consent_browser_context() ->> 'session_id'::text))::uuid AS uuid)))
